title: A Drop for the Debt
author: Lena Pemberton
blurb: Wren Ravensworth, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
